Description: A common name for a group of high molecular weight alkane hydrocarbons; a white, odorless, tasteless, waxy solid widely used as an embedding medium for tissue processing in histology.
A methyl ester of methacrylic acid; a reactive resin used as cement in dentistry, orthopaedic surgery, and ophthalmology, and as a hard plastic embedding medium for electron microscopy.
